description: The one-line command the USER runs to install a skill for an agent (aiqbench installs nothing), with its repository, commit, where it lands and its page. It pins the skills CLI version and the commit. Name the skill by ref or id from find_skills. A name that is only close to a skill's returns didYouMean and no command: ask which was meant. When several repositories share a name the answer says so (ambiguous, alternatives): tell the user which repository the command installs from. Pass commit to be told if aiqbench has since checked a newer one. Giving a command adds one to the skill's per-skill use counter (once per person per day; no prompt, account or address is stored).

commit.description: A full 40-character commit, as find_skills gave it

version.description: For a community skill: the version find_skills gave

name: install_command
title: Install command for a skill
